messages:
anna (AE): Heads-up: CedarPoint CFO requested a single-slide exec pack for 2026-03-26 call. Must cover KMS options, egress SLA (they're asking for 500 Mbps sustained), and a short commercial fallback. Need slide + 2-line commercial by EOD today.

mike (SE): Short tech summary: Private = BYOK (CloudHSM / Azure KeyVault) with no Redwood decrypt capability. Hosted = envelope-key model (customer wrapping key + Redwood-managed root). Direct HSM in Hosted requires a written product exception and exec signoff.

net-bot: NET ticket NET-7321 created for VPC peering to 10.55.0.0/22. Current ETA: 36-48h.

leo (Infra): Peering pending approval. For guaranteed 500 Mbps sustained we recommend a Dedicated reserved pool with an egress SLA (example: 500 Mbps sustained, 2 Gbps burst). Hosted public egress is best-effort unless we provision a dedicated egress path (ops change). If peering delayed, fallback = encrypted S3 presigned transfer + SQS ingestion runbook.

jen (Legal): Please draft the exact KMS clause and retention sentence to include in the addendum. Also confirm we'll attach SOC2 link and DPA.

sara (Solutions): Customer requires mTLS for peered flows and integrity checks on bulk transfers. Fallback plan acceptable: S3/SQS with HMAC verification. Also propose a 6-week migration path to Private with onboarding support.

nina (VP Sales): Commercial fallback proposal: Option A (Fallback): Hosted + Redwood-managed envelope keys with a +3% security uplift for first 12 months. Option B (Preferred): Private + Reserved Dedicated pool: 10% discount on committed usage (2yr) + $75k migration credit if they move to Private within 60 days.

anna (AE): Can someone paste 3 concise bullets (C-level friendly) + the 2-line commercial string by 17:30 PT? I'll assemble and send to the CFO.

mike (SE): Draft bullets:
```
- Transport: TLS1.3; mTLS for peered flows
- KMS: Private = BYOK (CloudHSM/Azure KeyVault). Hosted = envelope-key integration; HSM-in-Hosted requires exception.
- Egress: Dedicated reserved pool supports SLA (e.g., 500 Mbps sustained / 2 Gbps burst). Hosted = best-effort; fallback via encrypted S3/SQS.
- Logging: 90d default; extendable via contract
```

jen (Legal): Minor wording tweak for MSA: "For Private deployments, Customer-managed keys (CloudHSM or Azure KeyVault) are supported and Redwood will not have the ability to decrypt Customer ciphertext. For Hosted deployments, envelope-key integration is available; inclusion of HSM-backed keys in Hosted requires a written product exception and executive approval." That phrasing is good; I'll attach SOC2 link.

leo (Infra): I'll produce the one-slide diagram + 4-step runbook PDF and post a link within 45m. NET-7321 status remains pending; will update when approved.

nina (VP Sales): I'll standby for the CFO call and can join if procurement pushes back. Anna, escalate to me if peering or pricing can't be confirmed by EOD.

anna (AE): Thanks team  closing thread after slide + addendum uploaded.
